items.title: Slowing development does not have to wait for legislation
items.summary: Altman welcomed a federal AI framework while saying companies can slow development responsibly without waiting for a new law or an antitrust exemption.

items.title: Support for independent evaluators
items.summary: Altman backed Amodei’s proposal to give independent evaluators access comparable to employees, and said OpenAI would make the same commitment.

items.title: Welcoming Paul Christiano to the Foundation board
items.summary: Pachocki welcomed Christiano’s arrival at the OpenAI Foundation board and emphasized the work still ahead.

items.title: Chen addresses the Navier–Stokes data question
items.summary: Chen denied that people or agents examined user data for the specific mathematics effort, while acknowledging broader use of feedback and de-identified data to improve models. This is his account of the issue.

items.title: A demonstration of ChatGPT Images 2.5
items.summary: Brockman shared a demonstration highlighting the updated image model’s capabilities.

items.title: An Alien Mind: concerns about the next few years
items.summary: Pachocki shared his essay on AI progress, his concerns, and the choices needed to preserve human control.
